title: The password
starting_code:
# The password is ambrel in small letters.
# Stand beside the gate, say the word, and walk through.
hints: First, walk five steps to the right.
Use the `say` action to speak the password.
Do not forget the quotes! Then take two more steps to the right.
intro: I learned the secret word from an older pupil! You must stand right beside the gate and say exactly ambrel in small letters.
outro: The gate heard you! The way is open and we are inside the gatehouse.
learned: Now you know about words in quotes, which programmers call a string.
